exposure: Postpartum urinary retention (PPUR) following vaginal delivery
cohort: 242 women who previously experienced postpartum urinary retention (PPUR) following vaginal delivery between January 2013 and December 2019.
finding: Long-term lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) after postpartum urinary retention (PPUR) are uncommon, but hypothyroidism and postpartum uterine atony are identified as risk factors for long-term voiding dysfunction.
